report: Revision Kohn-Sham Rust solver: repeat (byte identity) and refined-tolerance comparison

checks.name: repeat_byte_identical
checks.detail: second run with the canonical options: 244 files (5854813 bytes) compared, same file set: True, differing files: none

checks.name: repeat_report_byte_identical
checks.detail: the solver check report of the repeat run is byte-identical to the canonical report

checks.name: outputs_lf_only
checks.detail: no CRLF line endings in the canonical outputs (offending: none)

checks.name: refined_same_inputs
checks.detail: the refined run selects the same N [8.0, 136.0, 688.0] and the same calibrated couplings (rounded to 4 significant digits) [(8.0, 0.01946, 0.05838), (136.0, 0.0009298, 0.002789), (688.0, 0.0001846, 0.0005538)]: N True, couplings True

checks.name: refined_free_spectra_convergence_order
checks.detail: analytic k = 0 spectra: max error canonical 5.050e-08, refined 3.157e-09; median error ratio 16.00 over 39 levels (RK4 order 4 predicts 16)

checks.name: refined_ground_energies
checks.detail: 75 ground states, same run set: True; max relative difference of E_KS 1.901e-12 (N688_lamp2_a10); tolerance 1e-08

checks.name: refined_ground_homo_lumo_gap
checks.detail: max |difference| of HOMO, LUMO, KS gap 1.300e-12 m (N136_lamp2_a00); tolerance 1e-08

checks.name: refined_eigenvalues
checks.detail: 23724 Kohn-Sham levels compared label by label: max |difference| 2.135e-09 m (N688_lamm1_a00 level 12:1:odd:2); label sets and occupations identical: True ; tolerance 1e-08

checks.name: refined_delta_scf
checks.detail: max |difference| of the Delta-SCF excitation energies 5.815e-11 m; tolerance 1e-08

checks.name: refined_profiles
checks.detail: proper profiles n, S, rho, p3, p_t, p8 at the 151 common y points: max difference / profile maximum 2.800e-09 (N136_lamp2_a00 p3); tolerance 1e-06

checks.name: refined_adiabatic_derivatives
checks.detail: Q_max, dE/da4 (EMT and finite differences): max relative difference 9.024e-10 (N136_lamp2_a20 Q_max); tolerance 1e-06

checks.name: refined_thermodynamics
checks.detail: 135 thermal states, same set: True; mu, E, F, Omega (both forms; relative to max(|x|, 1)) and S (relative to max(|S|, 1e-6)): max 2.489e-10 (N8_lam0_a20_T50 E); tolerance 1e-08

checks.name: refined_mermin_root_path
checks.detail: the canonical run solves sum g f = N with the form LogBalance, the refined run with LinearDeviation (exactly equivalent well-conditioned residuals of solver/src/mermin.rs with different rounding paths), so |canonical - refined| of mu and Omega contains the rounding error of the root instead of sharing it (the former direct count, the same in both runs, hid an error of 8.3e-10 m in N8_lamm1_a00_T10); max |mu_c - mu_r| 1.254e-12 m (N136_lamm1_a00_T20), max |Omega_c - Omega_r| 2.738e-10 (N688_lamm1_a00_T20); largest canonical rounding bound of mu (thermodynamics.csv mu_rounding_bound) 4.736e-14 (N688_lamm1_a20_T50)

checks.name: refined_heat_capacity
checks.detail: C_V = T dS/dT (Richardson): max relative difference (relative to max(|C_V|, 1e-6)) 5.689e-09 (N8_lam0_a20_T50); tolerance 1e-06
